notes.title: Bug Fixes/Improvements V.1.1.4
notes.notes:
You can now skip the credits, but not the two short cut scenes on the second level. That might be indefinite because the cut scenes are so short. Individual levels bug I thought would be fixed, but isn't. It will be soon. I'm also planning on adding a "Wipe Times" button.

Fixed a teleportation bug on Just climb and also fixed you being able to get out of the map on the third level.

notes.title: JUST CLIMB
notes.notes: Lots of bugs fixed, added a whole new section to just climb. No dialog, no story, just climbing. Maps will be added on over time.

notes.title: Well... v.1.0
notes.notes: I'll be adding more and more achievements, fixing more bugs here and there, but overall... This is it! Thanks for playing. Feedback is more than welcome, feel free to join the discord! This only works for play testers until the 31st. After the 31st, the game is open to anybody.
